card.name: Metformin renal transporter interaction wording
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside the metformin warning about drugs that interfere with renal tubular transport, especially 'organic' and the slash after OCT2. Also commas in lists of drugs competing for renal secretion.

modes.label: Metformin transporter sentence
modes.description: Word or slash in the phrase 'organic cationic transporter-2 [OCT2]/multidrug and toxin extrusion'.

modes.label: Drug list for tubular secretion
modes.description: Comma after a drug name in a list of drugs competing for renal tubular secretion.
modes.example: These drugs include: aspirin<<,>> phenylbutazone, sulfon

modes.label: Split long chemical name
modes.description: Start of a split enzyme name in a glucose monitoring warning.

card.plain: It lights up in the metformin warning about drugs that block kidney transport, mainly at 'organic' and the slash after OCT2.
evidence: These drugs include: aspirin<<,>> phenylbutazone, sulfon
